instruction: Access the recent email in Notes, extract the first image from the embedded document, and save it with the filename 'figure1.png' in your home folder.

metadata.explanation: Extracts first image (860x732, 30882 bytes) as figure1.png.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all essential instruction requirements: file existence, correct location (/home/user/figure1.png), PNG format, and image validity
Getter logic is sound: uses PIL to extract image properties (size, format, dimensions) and handles errors gracefully
Metric comparison logic is appropriate: progressive scoring (0.4 for existence, 0.2 each for size/format/dimensions) ensures file must exist before checking properties
Expected values are semantically correct: min_size=25000 bytes, format=PNG, min_width=800, min_height=700 match the actual image (860x732, 30882 bytes)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts properties from saved file, metric compares against expected thresholds
No postconfig needed: saved file persists after task completion, getter can read it directly
